rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, 1966). Bred by Alain Meilland (1940-....) (France, before 1966).
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) in 1966 as 'Chipper'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink. Mild fragrance. Small, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
